verdict.rationale: Weave records token usage and calculates cost for each call automatically on supported integrations, applying built-in per-model pricing, with custom costs available via `add_cost`. Per-call costs show in the trace tree and calls table, so per-request visibility is documented. However, the evidence shows no dashboard view that aggregates cost or tokens by model or over time; only a vague "native analytics tools" marketing mention exists. Missing for 10: dashboards aggregating cost/token usage by model, time-period trend views, independent or hands-on corroboration.
